# schema-inference

> Infer a JSON Schema 2020-12 from JSON records or CSV rows: merged types, nullability, required keys, nested objects and arrays, date and date-time formats Python package `trysac-schema-inference`, import name `schema_inference`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
